proposed_workflow_not_executed.default: Print help only; no writes or commands
proposed_workflow_not_executed.prepare: --prepare: refuse retained plan or configuration directories; freeze complete source comparison, proposed commands and protected manifests without invoking native tools
proposed_workflow_not_executed.build_debug: --build Debug only after parent review: compile isolated CU, then link actual authoritative objects with only this object substituted
proposed_workflow_not_executed.build_release: --build Release only after parent review: same isolated replacement with original Release flags
proposed_workflow_not_executed.protected: Canonical sources, current objects/tlogs/link sidecars, all tracked header/library dependencies (missing entries reject, never silently omit), actual main, tool pipeline exe/dll/libdevice, canonical executables/runtime/PDB/import libraries; verify plan before and all protected SHA/byte sizes after each build. Recursive inventories of source/bin and GPU object/tlog directories also reject any newly created or removed canonical file.
proposed_workflow_not_executed.output_isolation: Separate Debug/Release directories under this tag; explicit nvcc object, keep directory, dependency output, host PDB, TEMP/TMP/CUDA cache, link EXE/PDB/import LIB/ILK/LTCG IOBJ and manifest paths; cwd is isolated configuration directory
proposed_workflow_not_executed.manifests: New logs/cryer_symc_gpu_build_r1.inputs.json and separate Debug/Release build.json/build.log; record full argv, environment, inputs, actual nvcc dependency file/header hashes, runtime source/target hashes, warnings, tool exits and generated artifacts
proposed_workflow_not_executed.failure_policy: Fresh labels only; preserve failed outputs and never restart/overwrite. Any protected drift, unbound compiled dependency or native-tool failure rejects built_not_run. No solver invocation exists.
